title: LDAP filter built by concatenation (python) — review required
description: A python directory call assembles an LDAP filter from parts: .searchs*([^)]*(?:+|%|{). Filter metacharacters in untrusted input rewrite the query, bypassing authentication or dumping entries. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms escaping or parameterization.
remediation: Escape filter values with ldap3.utils.conv escape_filter_chars or use parameterized directory APIs.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled filter matches, including trusted ones.
